Title: Barcelona face new ground in Europe
Text: The Catalan club has never played against an Azerbaijani team in an official match before. Their upcoming clash marks a first-ever meeting with opposition from Azerbaijan, adding a brand-new chapter to Barça's European history.

Title: 9/9 from the spot: perfection for Barça
Text: Raphinha has taken 9️⃣ penalties for Barcelona and converted all 9️⃣, maintaining a flawless record from the spot for the Catalan club. Across his entire professional career, he has scored 22 of 23 penalties, missing just once. ✅ Career total: 22/23 (95.7% conversion rate)

Title: A shocking start for Barcelona
Text: By the 7th minute, Barcelona had already conceded two goals against Villarreal, with strikes from Tajon Buchanan (4:02) and Tani Oluwaseyi (6:10). 📊 It was the first time Barcelona had conceded twice within the opening seven minutes of a La Liga match since November 1981, when it happened against Real Zaragoza.

Title: Favorite Target
Text: 4️⃣ Fermín López is the player who has received the most assists from Lamine Yamal across all competitions for Barcelona this season.

Title: Penalty-Saving Specialist
Text: Among active goalkeepers, Wojciech Szczęsny stands alone at the top when it comes to stopping penalties. With 2️⃣1️⃣ penalty saves, he holds the reported lead among currently active goalkeepers. Penalty kicks typically favor the taker, making every save a potential game-changer. Szczęsny's total of 21 saved penalties underlines his exceptional reflexes, anticipation, and ability to perform when the odds are stacked against him.

Title: Spain's most important player
Text: Spain have won 80.5% of their competitive matches with Rodri since September 2022 (41 matches: 33 wins, 6 draws, 2 losses), compared to just 57.1% without the midfielder during the same period (21 matches: 12 wins, 6 draws, 3 losses).

Title: Teenage greatness
Text: Before turning 20, only three players have reached double digits for goals in the Champions League. Lamine Yamal with 14 goals now stands alone at the top of the list, surpassing both Mbappé and Haaland.

Title: Raphinha enters the elite
Text: 23 - FC Barcelona's top scorers in the Champions League: 120 - Lionel Messi, 25 - Luis Suárez, 23 - Robert Lewandowski, 23 - Raphinha.

Title: 100 Victories in Just 131 Matches
Text: Hansi Flick is now the eighth coach in Barcelona history to record 100 victories across all competitions. Reaching the mark in 131 games, he ranks second on the club’s all-time list for fastest to 100 wins, trailing only Luis Enrique’s 126-match record.

Title: One Goal, Two Assists
Text: Fermín López became only the second player to contribute to three goals in the first half of a 2026/27 La Liga match, recording one goal and two assists, after Yassir Zabiri against Elche, who was involved in all three goals himself.

Title: A Benchmark Across Europe's Top Five Leagues
Text: Lamine Yamal has contributed to 3️⃣ goals in a single match for FC Barcelona on 5️⃣ occasions across all competitions, all of them in 2026, including 3️⃣ this season. No player in Europe's top five leagues has achieved the feat more often in 2026/27.

Title: Déjà vu? 👀
Text: The last time Barça lost to Real Madrid on 25 October, they ended the season with a historic treble. That happened in 2014/15. And just like this season, a defeat to PSG had come beforehand.

Title: Back to his Nemesis 🔥
Text: José Mourinho will return to Camp Nou this Sunday for the first time in 4,990 days. His last appearance at Barcelona's iconic stadium came in March 2013, during his first spell as Real Madrid manager.

Title: On October 25, the stars align.
Text: 9 World Cup champions. The all-time leading scorer in World Cup history. The FIFA World Cup Golden Ball winner. A match bringing together an extraordinary collection of football icons, all on one stage.

Title: Lamine Yamal has reached 10 goals and 10 assists
Text: No other player in Europe's top five leagues has been the first to hit double figures in both categories during the current campaign. At just 18, Yamal continues to redefine expectations with his all-round attacking output.

Title: The Siege in Paris
Text: Barcelona endured relentless pressure in the first half, facing ten shots on target from PSG before the break. It is the most shots on target Barça have conceded in a Champions League first half since records from the 2003/04 season.

Title: Among the most prolific attacking runs ever recorded
Text: Barcelona's attack has reached historic levels in 2026. The Blaugrana have scored at least four goals in five of their eight Champions League matches this year, a 62.5% strike rate that matches the highest ever recorded in a calendar year by a team playing five or more European Cup games, alongside PSG in 2017.

Title: 🔴🔵 BRAVE. CONFIDENT. TOGETHER.
Text: Hansi Flick on whether PSG is an early final or a major test: “It will be a good test for us to see where we stand. I want my team to play with confidence, bravery and togetherness, just as we’ve done in recent matches.” “We’re facing arguably the best team in the world over the last two years. It’s a great opportunity to show our level and see what we can improve. After the match, we’ll know a lot more.”

Title: 8️⃣ Lamine Yamal
Text: Lamine Yamal has scored eight goals in LaLiga 2026/27, the highest tally by a Spanish player after the first nine matches of his club in a season of the competition since Diego Costa in 2013/14 (eight).

Title: 🎯 A Start For the Ages
Text: Barcelona has become the second team to win its first nine matches of a season in the entire history of La Liga, after Real Madrid in 1968/69.

Title: 10 - Lamine Yamal
Text: Lamine Yamal is the first player from Europe's five major leagues to reach 10 assists this season across all competitions.

Title: 11 - Rodri
Text: Rodrigo Hernández is the eleventh player to score for Barcelona in LaLiga 2026/27.
